definitions: A spiritual being believed to act as an attendant, agent, or messenger of God, conventionally represented as having a human form with wings and a long robe.
A person of exemplary conduct or virtue.
An extremely kind and lovable person.
A financial backer of an enterprise, especially a theatrical one.
A gold coin with the figure of the archangel Michael on it, formerly current in England.
examples: She's an angel for helping out.
My grandmother was an absolute angel.
They found an angel to fund the play.
